title: Judicial Process Record Details
description: Details of a judicial process (processo judicial) conforming to the Brazilian MNI/CNJ standard (Módulo Nacional de Interoperabilidade, Resolução CNJ 46).

OrgaoJulgador.title: Adjudicating body
OrgaoJulgador.description: The court or tribunal body adjudicating the process (órgão julgador).

codigoOrgao.title: Body code
codigoOrgao.description: Unique code identifying the adjudicating body within the tribunal system.

nomeOrgao.title: Body name
nomeOrgao.description: Full name of the adjudicating body.

codigoMunicipioIBGE.title: IBGE municipality code
codigoMunicipioIBGE.description: Brazilian IBGE numeric code for the municipality of the adjudicating body.

instancia.title: Judicial instance
instancia.description: The judicial instance of the adjudicating body, using the judicialInstance codelist.

AssuntoProcessual.title: Procedural subject
AssuntoProcessual.description: A subject-matter classification for the process using national TPU codes (Resolução CNJ 46) and/or local tribunal codes.

codigoNacional.title: National subject code
codigoNacional.description: National TPU subject code as defined by Resolução CNJ 46.

descricao.title: Description
descricao.description: Textual description of the subject matter.

MovimentoProcessual.title: Procedural movement
MovimentoProcessual.description: A procedural event or movement recorded in the process docket (andamento processual).

codigoNacional.title: National movement code
codigoNacional.description: National TPU movement code as defined by Resolução CNJ 46.

descricaoLocal.title: Local description
descricaoLocal.description: Tribunal-specific textual description of the movement.

dataHora.title: Date and time
dataHora.description: Date and time at which the movement was recorded.

identificadorMovimento.title: Movement identifier
identificadorMovimento.description: Unique identifier for the movement within the tribunal's system.

complemento.title: Complement
complemento.description: Additional textual information complementing the movement description.

VinculacaoProcessual.title: Process link
VinculacaoProcessual.description: A formal link between this process and a related process, using the judicialProcessBinding codelist.

tipo.title: Link type
tipo.description: The nature of the relationship between the two processes, using the judicialProcessBinding codelist.

numeroProcessoVinculado.title: Linked process number
numeroProcessoVinculado.description: The 20-digit CNJ unique number of the linked process.

Parametro.title: Additional parameter
Parametro.description: An extensible key/value pair for process data not covered by the standard structure (outroParametro).

nome.title: Parameter name
nome.description: The name of the additional parameter.

valor.title: Parameter value
valor.description: The value of the additional parameter.

numero.title: CNJ process number
numero.description: Unique CNJ process number per Resolution 65 — exactly 20 consecutive digits without mask (NNNNNNN-DD.AAAA.J.TT.OOOO without separators).

classeProcessual.title: Procedural class
classeProcessual.description: Procedural class code conforming to CNJ Resolution 46 (Tabelas Processuais Unificadas).

codigoLocalidade.title: Locality code
codigoLocalidade.description: Code identifying the locality or comarca where the process is filed.

nivelSigilo.title: Confidentiality level
nivelSigilo.description: Process confidentiality level: 0 (público) to 5 (sigilo absoluto). Controls which parties may access the process data.

intervencaoMP.title: Public ministry intervention
intervencaoMP.description: Whether the Ministério Público is intervening in the process.

dataAjuizamento.title: Filing date
dataAjuizamento.description: The date on which the process was filed (data de ajuizamento).

orgaoJulgador.title: Adjudicating body
orgaoJulgador.description: The court or tribunal body responsible for adjudicating the process.

valorCausa.title: Case value
valorCausa.description: The monetary value of the cause of action (valor da causa) in the currency of the jurisdiction.

assuntos.title: Procedural subjects
assuntos.description: Subject-matter classifications for the process using national TPU codes and/or local tribunal codes.

movimentos.title: Procedural movements
movimentos.description: Chronological record of procedural events and movements in the process docket.

outrosNumeros.title: Alternative process numbers
outrosNumeros.description: Legacy or alternative numbering schemes for this process.

vinculacoes.title: Process links
vinculacoes.description: Formal links to related processes (e.g. rescissory action, delegated jurisdiction, repetitive appeal, general repercussion).

outrosParametros.title: Additional parameters
outrosParametros.description: Extensible key/value pairs for process data not covered by the standard structure.
